claims.claim: Mativational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Witness photos show multiple business/self-help titles (e.g., “Influence People”, “Small Business Big Money”, “Compound Effect”, “This Is Marketing”, “Seth Godin”, “Women Rise Up”, “Sell Like Crazy”) consistent with motivational/business/self-development; at least one relationship-related title is visible (“Bringing Out the Best in Your Marriage”).

risks.risk: Condition risk (torn covers, missing pages, water damage, stains) that affects resale value.
risks.proof: One clear close-up of 2–3 random books’ spines and inner pages (open to show page condition) plus a photo of any damaged books if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed-condition used paperbacks (worst-case: some damaged/marked copies).

risks.risk: Unknown quantity and duplicates (too few books or many duplicates lowers value per book).
risks.proof: A single overhead shot showing the full stack/number of books, or a count shown on camera (e.g., books arranged in rows with total count visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an average-sized mixed bundle with possible duplicates.

risks.risk: Edition/printing year and format (paperback vs hardback) and whether any are special editions.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the copyright/printing page for 2 representative titles (showing year/edition and format).
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used paperbacks with unknown editions.

risks.risk: Completeness of titles (some books may be missing from what’s shown, or titles may be misrepresented).
risks.proof: A photo list/short video pan across all titles in the bundle so the full set is visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the visible titles only, assuming the rest may be lower-demand or not as advertised.

risks.risk: Bundle packaging/transport readiness (loose books may arrive damaged; bundled sets may be easier to sell).
risks.proof: Photo showing how the books are bundled (bag/box) and a quick shake/handling clip to show they’re secure.
risks.if_unproven: Price as loose/ungrouped used books (higher damage risk).

proof_requests: Show a full overhead photo/video of the entire bundle so the exact number of books is visible.
Take close-up photos of 2–3 random books’ inner pages (open the book) and spines to confirm page/copy condition.
Provide a close-up of the copyright/printing page for 2 representative titles to confirm edition/year and paperback format.
Show how the books are bundled/packed for sale (bag/box) to assess transport damage risk.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as an assorted bundle of business/self-help paperbacks, including at least one relationship title, so it can be priced at a worst-case mixed-used bundle value despite missing condition/quantity details.
